description:
Check a pending API key authorization using its request_id.

    Use request_id exactly as returned by request_api_key, never an email.
    Poll every 10 seconds. awaiting_user means the user must open the URL;
    pending means email verification is still required. ready returns the
    API key once only. Store it and include it in all subsequent HTTP calls.
    Stop on expired; ask the user before starting another authorization.
name: check_api_key_status
